messages.subject: Blue mussel help
parts:
Hello!

I am new to ecological models in R, and am looking to use NicheMapR to assess how different climate temperature scenarios affect the blue mussel Mytilus edulis.

I was wondering whether there is a tutorial for the “Dynamic energy budget model in the sea” shiny app, and whether this could be done in R?

I was also wondering whether there’s a manual for the NicheMapR package and some information surrounding the parameters, as I have tried to run the basic deb model using the Mytilus edulis data from A.M.P, and have had some problems with the parameters (It ran fine with Mytilus trossulus data)

Thanks in advance for your time!

Fabian

Hi Fabian,

Check out the website for NicheMapR which has the vignettes that are part of the package, and links to the tutorials for the shiny apps. All those apps are running in R. Unfortunately my server is non-responsive since Saturday morning so all the shiny apps are down right now.

All the best,
Mike
